facts.text: Grand Hyatt Amman sits atop one of Amman's seven hills, where modern and historic Amman meet.
facts.excerpt: At the heart of the city, where modern and historic Amman meet, a top one of the city’s most prominent seven hills

facts.text: The hotel has a distinctive carved pink stone facade and offers 360-degree views of the city.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Amman stands out with its distinctive carved pink stone façade, offering sweeping 360-degree views of the city.

facts.text: The hotel is on Hussein Bin Ali Street in Jabal Amman.
facts.excerpt: Hussein Bin Ali St., Jabal Amman, PO Box 831159, 11183 Amman, Jordan

facts.text: Blue Mosque View rooms overlook the old hills of Amman and the King Abdullah I Mosque with its blue mosaic dome.
facts.excerpt: overlooking the old hills of Amman and the famous King Abdullah I Mosque which is capped by a magnificent blue mosaic dome

facts.text: Deluxe rooms with poolside access have an outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Feel at home in this contemporary 36-square-meter room with an outdoor terrace and poolside access.

facts.text: Club rooms include access to the Grand Club Lounge on the 9th floor, with all-day refreshments, evening canapes and cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Guests staying in Club Rooms also enjoy exclusive access to the Grand Club Lounge on the 9th floor, offering all-day refreshments, evening canapés, alcoholic drinks, and cocktails.

facts.text: The Grand Royal Suite with Terrace has hand-picked artworks, a deep soaking bathtub and a terrace overlooking historic Amman.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the hand-picked artworks, deep soaking bathtub and the magnificent terrace overlooking historic Amman.

facts.text: The Royal Suite with Terrace offers panoramic views of historic Amman from its terrace.
facts.excerpt: Offering panoramic views of historic Amman from its spacious terrace

facts.text: Standard rooms have a marble bathroom with a separate bathtub and shower.
facts.excerpt: freshen up in the spacious marble bathroom that comes with a separate bathtub and shower

facts.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor swimming pools, with steam rooms, sauna and whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in a serene setting at our indoor and outdoor swimming pools, located on Level 1. Whether you are enjoying a refreshing swim, relaxing by the poolside, or rejuvenating in the steam rooms, sauna, and whirlpool

facts.text: Zara Spa offers body treatments.
facts.excerpt: Rebalance your physical and spiritual energy with a transforming body treatment or vigorous workout at Zara Spa on Level 1.

facts.text: The Zara Fitness Center has floor-to-ceiling windows that let in natural light.
facts.excerpt: our exclusive fitness center is open 24 hours a day with floor-to-ceiling windows allowing natural light to flood the space

facts.text: The Grand Hyatt Residences in the adjacent Hyatt Tower offer one- to four-bedroom serviced apartments with full kitchens and private balconies.
facts.excerpt: These one- to four-bedroom units feature full kitchens and private balconies offering breathtaking views of Amman.

facts.text: 32 North restaurant has a fiber-optic chandelier and glass walls looking onto a free-standing kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Through clever glass walls, diners can enjoy a view of the custom-made, free-standing kitchen

facts.text: The Lombard serves Northern Italian cooking with a modern take on traditional recipes.
facts.excerpt: serving Northern Italian cooking with a modern take on traditional recipes

facts.text: The Lounge has two large open fireplaces and a conservatory with floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: two large open fireplaces, floor-to-ceiling windows in the conservatory and a spectacular view

facts.text: The Terrace is a cocktail bar with water features.
facts.excerpt: Spacious and cozy in equal measure with soothing water features and a sleek cocktail bar

facts.text: The Citadel and the Roman Theatre are close to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: including the Citadel and Roman Theatre steps away

facts.text: Queen Alia International Airport is about a 30-minute drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: 30-minute drive to/from the hotel.

facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available to hotel guests.

facts.text: The hotel has a Grand Ballroom for weddings and celebrations.
facts.excerpt: Our magnificent Grand Ballroom offers a spectacular setting to celebrate every perfect moment.

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Amman is a Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards honoree in 2023 and 2026.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2023, 2026

facts.text: The hotel describes its dining as one of Jordan's finest culinary experiences.
facts.excerpt: Dining at Grand Hyatt Amman is one of Jordan’s finest culinary experiences.
